stem: As a behavioral strategy, 'stimulus control' involves which of the following actions?

options.text: Modifying environmental influences, such as not eating in front of the television.
Keeping a detailed food diary to track every calorie consumed.
Setting a goal to walk $10,000$ steps every single day.
Prescribing specific medications to suppress the physiological urge to eat.

explanation: Stimulus control focuses on restricting or changing the cues in the environment that trigger unhealthy behaviors.
rationale: Think about changes made to the surroundings to prevent unhealthy habits.

optionExplanations.A: Stimulus control focuses on restricting or changing the cues in the environment that trigger unhealthy behaviors.
optionExplanations.B: This describes 'self-monitoring,' which is a separate behavioral strategy mentioned in the text.
optionExplanations.C: This is an example of 'goal setting' rather than environmental stimulus control.
optionExplanations.D: This refers to pharmacotherapy, which addresses biology rather than environmental behavior triggers.
